question: Second Online National Conference on 'Sickle Cell Disease' in India was organized by which Ministry in June 2021?

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Tribal Affairs**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Second Online National Conference on '**Sickle Cell Disease**' was organized by the **Ministry of Tribal Affairs** in **June 2021**.
 
• The conference aimed to address the challenges faced by tribal populations in India due to Sickle Cell Disease.
